module.name: holoscan-yolo26
module.description: End-to-end YOLO26 object detection and instance segmentation on the GPU: a CUDA letterbox, TensorRT through the SDK's HoloInfer, and a GPU decode into boxes, scores, classes and a count, and for segmentation models per-instance masks and a label image at the image's size; and HoloViz overlays of the detections and masks. The models are not included: a tool exports them with a separately installed Ultralytics (AGPL-3.0).

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK, with TensorRT 10.

data.name: YOLO26 and YOLO26-seg (Ultralytics, AGPL-3.0)
data.description: Not part of this module. Its tools/prepare_model.py downloads pinned detection or segmentation weights and exports them to ONNX with the separately installed Ultralytics tool. The tests use stub models that the module writes itself.
